status: Paused at the requested 09:30 PST deadline. The 18-map work remains incomplete. Baku and Jeddah retain visual holds; Malaysia and Monaco have independent source-completion holds. Other visual passes remain limited by the stated survey and modeling caveats.
scope: 18 additional circuits. Silverstone, Monza, Interlagos and Las Vegas are accepted baselines, with their asset/runtime scope separately evidenced.

reviewer.method: Explicit root-adjudicated register of whole-route sheets and original pose-qualified critical frames. Source/geometry proofs do not substitute for fresh visual review.

checks.native: All guarded native, contact, support, limits, camera and preserved Las Vegas dynamic-lap checks passed.
checks.package: Package 219ac9a7 built and pinned. Its executable is identical to 0e32f075. Fresh complete recordings cover the three subsequently changed scenes.
checks.live_flow: All five first-wave changed scenes completed clean laps covering 125 of 125 route bins. Final Hockenheim, Spa and Monaco captures on 219ac9a7 also completed clean full laps. Original captured revisions are retained.
checks.performance: Only the explicitly current uncapped moving runs below establish measured full-route frame times after a full warmup. Coverage is partial across the 18 circuits. Historical stationary and moving samples retain their original revisions and are excluded from the current table. No all-circuit performance parity is claimed.

malaysia.reason: T15 remains flat despite primary confirmation of adverse post-2016 crossfall. Its numerical transverse profile and entry/exit warp need qualification.

monaco.reason: Casa Mia and Villa Marie Antoinette use under-height generic bodies. Strongly matched IGN components establish larger, separate measured envelopes; component-aware modeling and fresh validation remain pending.

preservation.accepted_four_content_unchanged: Accepted Silverstone, Monza, Interlagos and Las Vegas content and shared Generated assets remain unchanged.
preservation.round_two_scope: Compared with 92dca960, only Hockenheim physical map data changed. Other 17 circuits retain exact physical data. All 73 physical files are identical between 0e32f075 and 219ac9a7.
preservation.runtime_implementation: Optional bank-height/contact evaluators and Spa-specific daylight changed; do not interpret preservation as no implementation changes.

data.runtime_change_scope: Optional measured bank-edge height, support, slope and fallback rendering; Spa-only daylight orientation. Shared vehicle tuning and camera source untouched.

data.physical_data: Unchanged versus0e32f075. Spa render_tiles.csv is a visual residency/bounds manifest; its refined mesh bounds intentionally changed, not the native height/contact data.

data.note: Retain the original captured revision; exact executable and complete per-scene native/source identity permit carrying this sample. Monaco changed mesh grouping again and needs a fresh sample.

bank_height.description: Optional progressive quadratic banking and measured bank-edge fade now share height/slope functions between simulation, tyre support and rendered geometry. Default paths and unaffected physical data retain their exact outputs; shared vehicle tuning and camera code are unchanged.

spa_daylight.description: Spa alone rotates the sky, dome and sun by 120 degrees at unchanged energy, elevation and exposure. The ineffective 0.06 normal-strength trial was rejected and 0.18 restored. Source grid heights and native data are unchanged. A bounded 0.25 m mesh represents the existing field within 2.517 cm in the visible core and rejoins the actual old outer triangle planes. Fresh full-route visual review passes; residual tone and rounded-hollow differences lack matched source classification.

resources.scope: Sampled total machine usage, not engine RSS. The hash covers the parsed byte prefix if monitoring continues. Sampling cannot establish every transient peak or job concurrency by itself.

known_limits: Dense native controls do not make reconstructed widths, event radii, height fields or temporary architecture into surveys.

Six tested Baku pixel rays establish old-city exterior ground intrusions, with additional facade/terrain cuts. These are ray witnesses, not six separately mapped defects. The attempted public-paving/foundation repair failed grade/join qualification and remains unintegrated in its preserved candidate archive.
Malaysia T15 still has zero modeled bank despite primary confirmation of post-2016 adverse crossfall. Exact magnitude and entry/exit warping remain unresolved.

Portimao classified DGT ground yields a maximum 100 m rise of 8.45%, inconsistent with the operator headline 6.2%. The source-definition difference is unresolved; no unsupported vertical rescaling was applied.
Japan now uses registered GSI widths around 10 to 15 m; the operator 16 m extremum is not yet locally registered. Road-top separation at the crossing is not underside clearance.
Zandvoort T3 now uses the measured progressive quadratic bowl and bounded paved bank. Cross-sections and source epochs still carry their stated uncertainties.
Buddh T1-to-T3 has an FIA climb constraint; other terrain retains coarse DSM uncertainty. Generic width controls remain at several venues, including parts of Australia/Canada/China/COTA/Singapore.
Ordinary city facades, vegetation and crowds remain stylized. A visual pass is limited to its exact current scene, whole-route sampled sheets and original critical views.
Automated native/live laps do not establish physical-controller handling or all menu/input paths. Reference clips can contain edited cuts and different cameras.
Only explicit uncapped moving samples establish measured whole-route frame times. Stationary samples and capped image recordings have separate scopes.
Hockenheim visible stand-front join is closed; a hidden mismatch up to 1.479 m remains outside the bounded repair. No broad earth bank was invented to conceal it.
